overall_goal: Log the nutritional values of various ingredients, manage the boiling pot, and clean up the kitchen

goals.description: Record the nutritional value of the red pepper
goals.rationale: The person weighs the red pepper and uses their phone to record its nutritional value.

goals.description: Record the nutritional value of the spinach
goals.rationale: The person uses their phone to record the nutritional measurements of the spinach.

goals.description: Record the nutritional value of the canned beans
goals.rationale: The person uses their phone to scan the barcode and record the nutritional value of the canned beans.

goals.description: Retrieve utensils and a plate from the kitchen drawers
goals.rationale: The person opens kitchen drawers multiple times to retrieve a can opener, a small plate, and a spoon.

goals.description: Scoop beans into a bowl and place the colander in the sink
goals.rationale: The person transfers salad beans from the colander into a bowl and places the used colander and spoon in the sink.

goals.description: Store various ingredients in the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person organizes and stores various vegetables and a bowl of beans in the refrigerator.

goals.description: Weigh and record the nutritional value of the coriander
goals.rationale: The person weighs the coriander on the kitchen scale and records its nutritional value using a phone app.

goals.description: Record the nutritional value of the tuna
goals.rationale: The person uses their phone to scan and record the nutritional value of the canned tuna.

goals.description: Manage the boiling pot and empty the water
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly checks the boiling pot on the stove, adjusts the temperature, and eventually removes it to empty the water.

goals.description: Store leftover spinach and coriander in the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person puts the leftover spinach and coriander away in the refrigerator.

goals.description: Add tuna to the salad bowl and place the plate in the sink
goals.rationale: The person opens the tuna can, adds it to the salad bowl, and places the dirty plate in the sink.

goals.description: Wrap the bowl with a plastic sheet and store it in the refrigerator
goals.rationale: The person decides against using aluminum foil, retrieves plastic sheets to wrap the bowl, stores the bowl in the refrigerator, and puts the plastic sheets away.

goals.description: Mix pasta in the strainer and place items in the sink
goals.rationale: The person clears a lid into the sink, mixes the pasta in the strainer, and then places the strainer in the sink.

goals.description: Clean up the kitchen counter and dispose of trash
goals.rationale: The person gathers trash and utensils from the counter to clean up and opens the dustbin to dispose of the waste.
The person retrieves a towel or tablecloth to dry their hands at various points.
